description: Main application component for the Phone Review Platform frontend. Manages state for reviews, search, modal visibility, and selected videos; renders key UI components including header, review lists, and modal; contains mock review data.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates the search state based on user input.

methods.name: openModal
methods.description: Sets modalOpen state to true, opening the review modal.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Sets modalOpen state to false, closing the review modal.

methods.name: handleAddReview
methods.description: Adds a new review to the reviews list, generating a unique ID and resetting comments and rating.

methods.name: handleRate
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific review by averaging the existing rating with the new rating.

methods.name: handleComment
methods.description: Adds a user comment to a review.
